changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
Plex is faster on every box: posters come down at the size they are drawn, libraries no longer download your whole collection in the background, moving through the menu and rails no longer reloads what you pass, and older boxes get the lighter layout automatically.
Plex keeps your place: closing a movie or episode puts you back exactly where you were (the same rail, the same episode list), each rail remembers where you left it, and holding OK no longer opens a title and then plays it.
Plex settles before it shows: a short "Getting Plex ready…" while every Home rail and its posters load, so the screen is smooth the moment it appears instead of stuttering while rows arrive behind the remote. Capped at nine seconds.
Plex search: before you type, a row of Popular searches (what everyone has been looking for) and your Recent searches on this box. Down from the search box lands on them, OK searches.
Plex search forgives typos: a missing apostrophe, colon or letter no longer means no results — a "Did you mean" row offers the closest titles, and OK opens one.
Plex Home: Recently Added and Recently Released go a hundred titles deep, and the rails only draw the tiles near the highlight, so scrolling them is smooth on any box.
Live TV: a VOD section is back in the menu with your line's movies, and Plex pinned first — OK takes you straight into Plex, and Back brings you back to VOD. Live TV now opens with the highlight on the categories.
Live TV is lighter: programme info only loads for the channels on screen, categories load when you stop on one instead of for every one you pass, channel lists are let go when you leave, and radio channels no longer restart every few seconds.
Remote media buttons work in the Player: Play/Pause pauses and resumes Live TV, Plex, VOD and Backups; Fast-forward and Rewind skip 30 s ahead / 10 s back in films and episodes, and change channel in Live TV.
Multi-Screen: the channel picker is a big, readable panel, and Back from a full-screen tile returns to your screens instead of the layout chooser.
Live TV and VOD: the category list scrolls with the highlight all the way down. The Grid layout is now called Vibez and no longer plays a hidden preview.
Opening the old Dreamstreams, VibezTV or Plex app now suggests the Player, with what it adds; Continue opens the app as before, and "Don't show this again" turns the suggestion off.
Buffering guide redesigned: bigger text you can read from the couch, a step tracker across the top, large answer buttons, the main button first on every step, and your results with Send to support right at the top.
Main Apps: Dreamstreams, VibezTV and Plex now point you to the Player. They live under Live TV and Plex there; Open Player takes you straight to the right section.

FIXES
Older Android boxes (X96, T95): the Dashboard and Settings buttons sit at the top right again instead of over the logo.
Plex: the side menu and the content start below the TV's overscan band, so the server line is no longer cut off at the top. Left from the search box goes back to the menu.
Device Cleaner: the button titles are white again instead of dark grey on blue.

Plus everything in 1.7.6: Plex opens lighter and kinder to small boxes, and nothing adult on the content bar or the Plex Home, Discover and Search rails.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.7 makes Plex faster on every box (tile-sized posters, no home-screen chores under the rails), settles Plex before it appears, forgives typos in Plex search with a Did-you-mean row, adds popular and recent searches, brings VOD back to Live TV with Plex pinned first, makes Live TV lighter on memory, deepens the Home rails to a hundred titles, points Dreamstreams, VibezTV and Plex in Main Apps to the Player, and fixes the header on older Android boxes. Installs normally over 1.7.6.
